messages:
Raj Patel: Hey team — need quick approval for a custom pricing ask from Helix Med. They want 40% off hosted API list for the first 12 months + net-60 payment terms. Account owner says expected ARR ~ $1.2M after ramp and they plan to move to Dedicated in year 2. They've asked for a signed SOW + SOC2 evidence. Link to draft SOW: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/helix-sow (internal access).
Emma Li: Thanks Raj. Can you post the math? baseline list rate and the discounted rate, plus expected monthly commit and margin impact? Also flag if PHI/BAA needed.
Raj Patel: Baseline list: $0.06 / 1k tokens. They propose 40% off -> effective $0.036 / 1k for 12 months. Expected usage: ~1.6B tokens/month at scale -> ~$96k/mo at list, ~$57.6k/mo at 40% off. That's roughly $690k ARR first year if they ramp mid-quarter vs our $1.2M target when fully onboarded.
Nico Alvarez: Quick note from RevOps: net-60 is outside standard (we do net-30). For anything over 30 days we require credit approval and either prepayment or a rolling reserve. Also discounts >30% need CFO signoff per pricing policy (see internal doc).
Maria Gomez: Legal flag — Helix is handling PHI. We will need a BAA and updated Data Processing Addendum. Also check their security questionnaire; SOC2 alone may not be enough depending on the workload.
Emma Li: Thanks. On the margin side, at 40% off the unit margin goes negative if usage is heavy on hosted inference with burst GPUs. Need to know whether they'll go Dedicated in year 2 (what we will assume for margin recovery). If we accept net-60, require a 3-month prepayment or an approved credit line.
Raj Patel: They confirmed they'd migrate to Dedicated in ~12–18 months but want low entry cost. Sales suggests a ramp: 40% year 1, 20% year 2, then list. They prefer net-60 to keep runway.
Tom Brooks: Looping in CFO — Tom here. I'm open to exception but with conditions. Approve a max 35% off list for year 1 (not 40%), require net-30 or net-60 only with a 3-month prepayment hold or letter of credit, require completed credit check and finance-approved SOW. Also need Legal to sign BAA + security checklist complete before production. We should add a clause: discount clawback if they churn within 9 months.
Raj Patel: Understood — 35% year 1, net-30 unless they provide LOC or 3mo prepay. I'll ask them for LOC option. If they accept LOC then we can do net-60. Will update the quote.
Nico Alvarez: Please submit formal Deal Desk packet (quote, SOW, expected ARR ramps, credit report) and tag me. I’ll run the revenue recognition and billing flow.
Maria Gomez: I'll draft BAA + redline SOW. Flagging security: need penetration test report or attestation for PHI.
billing-bot: draft_invoice: created draft invoice #D-1780428600 for Helix Med (status: pending review).
Tom Brooks: Final: conditional approval from me — approve 35% off Y1, 20% Y2, require either 3mo prepay or LOC to allow net-60, BAA signed, credit check cleared, and discount clawback clause. Finance to confirm before executing.
Emma Li: Thanks. I'll put this into the approval tracker and mark as CFO-conditional-approved. Raj, can you confirm when you have the LOC or prepay?
Raj Patel: Will do — aiming to get LOC by EOD Thursday. If they push back, we'll present the 35% with net-30 option. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
